findings.title: No consent banner or US opt-out mechanism
findings.detail: 4 advertising platform(s) fire (Campaign Manager 360 / Floodlight, Google Ads, Google Merchant Center, Meta Pixel); no CMP, no geo-targeted banner markup and no 'Do Not Sell or Share' / 'Your Privacy Choices' link were found.
findings.recommendation: Enable Shopify's privacy banner (or a CMP) with region rules: opt-in for EU/UK, opt-out link + GPC for US state privacy laws (CCPA/CPRA and others).

findings.title: Not met: No purchase tags tied to Shopify thank-you / checkout URLs — GTM-WTVHJNR
findings.detail: 1 active tag(s) fire on checkout / thank-you URLs or events: Google Ads Conversion #4 (554155084). This container loads on the storefront, and with Checkout Extensibility it no longer runs on checkout or thank-you pages, so these tags most likely never fire. Why it matters: Missing purchase conversions starve bidding algorithms and understate ROAS.
findings.recommendation: Move purchase conversions to Shopify Customer Events (app pixel or a custom pixel subscribing to checkout_completed), then confirm Google Ads / Meta purchase conversions are recording.

findings.title: Not met: GA4 — One implementation per property
findings.detail: G-YBG65XL6PS <- Shopify app: Google & YouTube x12, Shopify custom pixel #100204730 x6 Why it matters: Two implementations double-count events and revenue.
findings.recommendation: Keep one implementation per property - on Shopify usually the Google & YouTube app, unless GTM carries a richer setup (then switch GA4 off in the app).

findings.title: Not met: GA4 — Page view sent once per load
findings.detail: Duplicates on one page load: G-YBG65XL6PS×2 (from Shopify app: Google & YouTube, Shopify custom pixel #100204730) Why it matters: Double page views inflate traffic and deflate conversion rates; for ad pixels they distort optimisation.
findings.recommendation: Remove the second source (app vs GTM vs hard-coded / custom pixel).

findings.title: Needs attention: GA4 — Add to cart event sent (add_to_cart)
findings.detail: No add_to_cart event in the atc phase (cart add redirected — verify in the platform's debugger). Why it matters: Product-level events drive dynamic ads, retargeting audiences and value-based optimisation.
findings.recommendation: Send add_to_cart on every cart add (incl. drawer/AJAX carts).

findings.title: Needs attention: GA4 — Single deployment route
findings.detail: Hits come from 2 routes: Shopify app: Google & YouTube x12; Shopify custom pixel #100204730 x6. Why it matters: Parallel routes double-count, drift apart, and make consent handling inconsistent.
findings.recommendation: On Shopify, keep the native app integration (server-side events, consent API, maintained by the platform) and remove the GTM / theme / custom-pixel copy unless it adds something the app can't.

findings.title: Needs attention: Google Ads — Single deployment route
findings.detail: Hits come from 2 routes: GTM GTM-WTVHJNR x16; Shopify app: Google & YouTube x10. Why it matters: Parallel routes double-count, drift apart, and make consent handling inconsistent.
findings.recommendation: On Shopify, keep the native app integration (server-side events, consent API, maintained by the platform) and remove the GTM / theme / custom-pixel copy unless it adds something the app can't.

findings.title: Needs attention: Meta — event_id on standard events (CAPI dedupe)
findings.detail: 9 of 15 standard events (AddToCart, PageView, ViewContent) carry event_id. Missing on events from: Shopify app: Meta (Facebook & Instagram), Theme inline script. Why it matters: Without event_id, pixel + Conversions API events double-count and Meta's optimisation degrades.
findings.recommendation: Send a shared event_id with every standard event and its Conversions API twin.

findings.title: Needs attention: Meta — Single deployment route
findings.detail: Hits come from 2 routes: Shopify app: Meta (Facebook & Instagram) x13; Theme inline script x4. Why it matters: Parallel routes double-count, drift apart, and make consent handling inconsistent.
findings.recommendation: On Shopify, keep the native app integration (server-side events, consent API, maintained by the platform) and remove the GTM / theme / custom-pixel copy unless it adds something the app can't.

findings.title: Needs attention: Enhanced conversions configured — GTM-WTVHJNR
findings.detail: No user-provided data (enhanced conversions) on Ads conversion tags. Why it matters: Typically recovers a meaningful share of conversions lost to cookie restrictions.
findings.recommendation: Enable enhanced conversions (hashed email/phone from the dataLayer) on purchase.

findings.title: Needs attention: Google Ads — Dynamic remarketing sends product IDs
findings.detail: No product IDs on Ads hits from the product page or cart. Why it matters: Dynamic remarketing and PMax product audiences need product IDs that match the feed.
findings.recommendation: Send items (id matching the Merchant Center feed) with view_item / add_to_cart.

findings.title: Needs attention: Meta — Single Meta pixel
findings.detail: 2 Meta pixels receive data: 360270341980016, 364039191513066. Why it matters: Extra IDs split audiences and send customer data to accounts nobody watches.
findings.recommendation: Confirm each is owned and in use; retire leftovers from agencies or old accounts.

findings.title: Needs attention: Meta — Add to cart sent once per cart add
findings.detail: Sent 2× to 360270341980016 for a single cart add. Why it matters: Double add-to-cart events inflate funnel rates and remarketing audience signals.
findings.recommendation: Find the second trigger (app + theme script, or two listeners) and keep one.
